facts.value: Admission is restricted based on the score of the general higher education entrance qualification.
Applicants for the first semester in the Business Education program must register in advance at hochschulstart.de.
Information about the application process for the 1st semester can be found in the informational sheet.
If prior studies have been completed at another university, the 'Declaration of Recognition of Examination Achievements' must be submitted with the application documents.
A recognition of examination achievements form must be printed and submitted with the application documents.
